title: Prenatal Alcohol Exposure and Congenital Heart Defects: A Meta-Analysis.
authors: Yang J, Qiu H, Qu P, Zhang R, Zeng L, Yan H.
quote: However, prenatal alcohol drinking was marginally significantly associated with conotruncal defects (CTDs) (OR = 1.24, 95% CI = 0.97-1.59) and statistically significantly associated with d-Transposition of the Great Arteries (dTGA) (OR = 1.64, 95%CI = 1.17 -2.30).
